_comment: Synthetic hot-water plant (generator hw_plant_cycling, camber.datasets._synthetic; 0.104, #137) -> CAMBER Role mapping. Every column is CAMBER's own: BLR_FIRE is the burner firing (1 = firing, not an enable), HWS_T / HWR_T the loop supply and return in F, HWP_SPD the hot-water pump's speed in %, HW_DP the loop differential pressure and HW_DP_SP its setpoint in psi, OAT the outdoor temperature in F. The scenario column selects one plant per ingest run and is not a point.
